BiblicalUsage: Sarsekim stands in one verse only, and it is a terrible one. When the princes of the king of Babylon came in and sat in the middle gate of Jerusalem, Sarsechim was among them, as the city fell.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that his name is preserved as a witness to the fall — a foreign general seated in the gate of God's city on the day judgment came.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
